messages:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — incident yesterday where a staged rollout flipped to a bad model variant and traffic routing delayed rollback. Listing remediation owners and timelines below. Please ack and update owner/timeline if this looks off.

liam: ack. I'm taking ownership of the auto-rollback config and instrumentation. Goal: draft config + telemetry in 3 business days. High level: auto-rollback when error-rate > 5% for 2m AND p95 latency > 2s, with a minimum request floor.

sofia: I can own blast-radius controls for feature flags. ETA end of week to add a standard flag template (max-percentage, per-region caps) and a quarantine timer. Will include tests for flag excursions.

kai: I'll pick up canary sampling improvements + rollout event schema change for better observability. Estimate 1 week; will add a small staged-traffic simulator to validate behavior.

deploy-bot: deploy.log — canary start 2026-03-15T14:02:11Z; image v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0; at ~14:06Z error-rate spiked to 9% for ~3m. Auto-rollback not triggered because min_requests threshold not met. :warning:

maya: Action items summary I'll own creating the tracker card in the postmortem board and linking PRs. Proposal: label all follow-ups with `postmortem:rollout`, add `owner:<name>` and `due:<date>`. Also propose weekly 15m check-ins for 3 weeks to observe regressions.

liam: Config snippet I want to PR for infra (quick draft):
```yaml
rollback:
  enabled: true
  error_rate_threshold: 0.05
  window_seconds: 120
  min_requests: 100
  backoff_minutes: 10
```
I'll add telemetry events `rollback.triggered` + `rollback.reason` and a dashboard.

sofia: Blast-radius defaults I'm proposing: `max_percentage: 10`, `per_region_max: 25`, `quarantine_timer_seconds: 300`. Also an emergency override path that requires 2 approvers. Will write runbook.

kai: Also suggest adding synthetic warmup traffic to canary start sequence (30s ramp) so KV-cache and kernel JITs stabilize before counting errors. I'll add a task for the simulator and perf-suite test.

maya: thanks all. Please update the tracker with exact PR numbers and use labels: `postmortem:rollout`, `severity:high`, `phase:remediation`. I'll create the first calendar invite for the check-ins and ping owners 24h before each. :thumbsup:
